headline.en: US Private Credit Default Rate Hits Record 6.3%, Fitch Says
headline.zh: Fitch称美国私人信贷违约率创下6.3%的纪录

summary.en: Fitch reported that the US private credit default rate reached a record 6.3%. The article consisted only of the headline and did not provide further detail.
summary.zh: Fitch报告称，美国私人信贷违约率升至创纪录的6.3%。文章仅包含标题，未提供更多细节。

headline.en: Neuberger launches new aerospace financing platform
headline.zh: Neuberger 推出新的航空金融平台

summary.en: Neuberger has launched a new aerospace financing platform, according to Alternative Credit Investor. No financial terms, partners or leadership were disclosed in the report.
summary.zh: 据 Alternative Credit Investor 报道，Neuberger 已推出一个新的航空金融平台。报道未披露任何财务条款、合作方或管理层信息。

headline.en: Neuberger launches New Bridge Aero aerospace financing platform
headline.zh: Neuberger 推出 New Bridge Aero 航空融资平台

summary.en: Neuberger Specialty Finance has launched a new aerospace financing platform, New Bridge Aero, aiming to build a portfolio in excess of $2bn. The facility will seek to originate and acquire loans and other debt instruments across the aerospace sector offering downside protection and durable cash flows.
summary.zh: Neuberger Specialty Finance 推出了新的航空融资平台 New Bridge Aero，目标是构建超过 20 亿美元的资产组合。该融资工具将寻求在航空领域发起和收购贷款及其他债务工具，这些工具提供下行保护和持久现金流。
